guardrails: Code hash verification enabled; modified/uncovered code uses fallback.
No game-memory patch or startup bypass.
No FPSCR/register masks or address whitelists in live replay.
Reference-created states were not used in native progression.
scope_notes: Cold boot and first mission used the pre-FMA module; final module separately tested using the native-created first-fight state.
The final differential window ends at native dispatch index 2000000, not at two million comparisons.
Candidate counts include explicit fallback/zero-charge skips.
Native dispatch counters are not PowerPC instruction counts or native-coverage percentages.
The first pre-FMA differential replay required SIGTERM after its stop deadline; it is not counted as passing.
Helper comparison is against pinned reference code, not an independent physical Wii trace.
